text:
Zoe (marketing PM): FYI the NimbusEdge case draft is ready in Drive. We pulled two quote variants from their VP of ML. Need legal signoff + customer approval by Thu 5pm to make next Tuesday's launch. Also exploring a joint webinar on Jun 2 1—who can own registration and the landing page?

Carlos (producer): I'll take registration + landing page. Proposed schedule: hero quote Mon AM, transcript edits Mon PM, design Tues morning.

Priya (legal): Paste the exact quote copy here. Watch numeric claims; we need either proof or softer language. Confirm we have logo usage rights.

Zoe (marketing PM): Quotes below — long and short.

Carlos (producer): Quote (verbatim): "After moving to Redwood, we cut inference spend by 65% and our p99 latency dropped by over 40%, which let us iterate faster."

Priya (legal): Flags: "65%" and "p99"/"40%" are quantitative. Either include benchmark appendix or change to: "substantially reduced inference costs" and "material p99 latency improvements." Also replace "iterate faster" -> "accelerate iterations." Need confirmation on logo release.

Nikhil (growth): For inbound routing, suggest tag nimbus_launch and route demo signups to nimbus_sdr queue; I'll set up a short nurture and add UTM params.

mkt-bot: Created ticket MKT-902: "NimbusEdge case study legal review & webinar landing" and assigned to Carlos.

Carlos (producer): Short hero candidate: "NimbusEdge reduced inference cost and improved latency with Redwood, enabling faster iterations."

Priya (legal): Edit short hero: change "reduced inference cost" -> "reduced inference costs" and "faster iterations" -> "accelerated iterations." Final: "NimbusEdge reduced inference costs and improved latency with Redwood, enabling accelerated iterations." Approved pending customer signoff and logo permission.

Zoe (marketing PM): Thanks. @Nikhil confirm SDR queue and opt-in language? @Carlos please drop final hero text into Figma by Tue 9am. I'll ping NimbusEdge for signoff now.

Nikhil (growth): Confirmed queue nimbus_sdr exists. Opt-in copy: "By registering you agree to be contacted about Redwood products and events." UTM: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=nimbus_launch

Carlos (producer): Figma link: https://redwood.app/figma/nimbus-hero 0 - will upload frames.

Priya (legal): Approved as edited. :white_check_mark: Waiting on signed logo/media release from customer.

Zoe (marketing PM): Great work team 1 I'll update when customer confirms and then we can schedule publish + webinar invites."
